cases.name: short-help
cases.stdout:
Simple program to greet a person

Usage: greet [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> [GREETING]

Arguments:
  [GREETING]  Greeting to use instead of "Hello"

Options:
  -n, --name <NAME>      Name of the person to greet
  -c, --count <COUNT>    Number of times to greet [default: 1]
  -v...                  Increase verbosity
  -t, --tag <TAG>        Tag to attach (repeatable)
      --lang <LANG>      Language of the greeting [env: GREET_LANG=]
      --color <COLOR>    Colour of the output [default: auto] [possible values: always, never, auto]
      --offset <OFFSET>  Offset added to the count [default: 0]
  -s, --shout            Shout the greeting
  -h, --help             Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version          Print version

cases.name: long-help
cases.stdout:
Simple program to greet a person

Greets NAME a number of times. This second paragraph only appears in the long help (`--help`), as clap's `long_about`.

Usage: greet [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> [GREETING]

Arguments:
  [GREETING]
          Greeting to use instead of "Hello"

Options:
  -n, --name <NAME>
          Name of the person to greet

  -c, --count <COUNT>
          Number of times to greet
          
          [default: 1]

  -v...
          Increase verbosity

  -t, --tag <TAG>
          Tag to attach (repeatable)

      --lang <LANG>
          Language of the greeting
          
          [env: GREET_LANG=]

      --color <COLOR>
          Colour of the output

          Possible values:
          - always: Always colour the output
          - never:  Never colour the output
          - auto:   Colour the output when stdout is a terminal
          
          [default: auto]

      --offset <OFFSET>
          Offset added to the count
          
          [default: 0]

  -s, --shout
          Shout the greeting.
          
          Prints the greeting in upper case and appends an exclamation mark. Only `--help` shows this paragraph.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
